skill.name: small-budget-ads
skill.description: Guides small-budget Meta Ads reviews using conversation costs, historical benchmarks, and data sufficiency checks. Requires explicit approval before account changes.
skill.summary: Review small-budget Meta conversation campaigns using spend thresholds, historical benchmarks, and explicit approval for account changes.
skill.author: rabbitdesigns22

security_audit.summary: The reconnaissance finding is a false positive: SKILL.md:67 discusses advertising bid limits, not system inspection. No evidence found of malicious instructions or data exfiltration. The skill requires explicit owner approval for account changes.

content.user_title: Review Small-Budget Meta Ads Before Making Changes
content.value_statement: Small advertising budgets produce limited data that can make useful ads appear unsuccessful. This skill guides Meta campaign reviews using historical benchmarks and explicit approval.
actual_capabilities: Guide reviews using seven full days since the last significant edit and a historical cost-per-conversation benchmark.
Distinguish untested ads from poor performers using spend relative to each ad set's benchmark.
Recommend retaining ads, replacing creative, or investigating delivery failures based on campaign evidence.
Keep comparisons within the same ad set or product while checking account currency and reporting totals.
Structure creative briefs with winning and losing examples plus two or three different ideas.
Require explicit approval for each account change and verification afterward in Ads Manager.
limitations: Provides written decision guidance, not a bundled Meta API integration or campaign automation script.
Requires supplied metrics or authorized account access to inspect performance, previews, and billing status.
Focuses on small-budget Meta conversation campaigns, not every advertising platform or campaign objective.
Uses screening heuristics rather than statistically significant tests and does not guarantee lower advertising costs.

use_cases.title: Review a local service campaign
use_cases.description: Identify ads with enough spend to judge while preserving separate budgets for the services the business wants to promote.

use_cases.title: Review accounts with different currencies
use_cases.description: Check account currency, reporting totals, and each ad set's historical benchmark before recommending changes across client accounts.

use_cases.title: Plan the next creative batch
use_cases.description: Turn performance evidence and inspected previews into replacement briefs for the same product without changing proven ads.

prompt_templates.title: Check whether there is enough data
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these Meta conversation ads: [metrics]. The currency is [currency], and the last significant edit was [date]. Identify missing data before recommending changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small account

prompt_templates.title: Classify ads within one ad set
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [historical cost per conversation] as this ad set's benchmark. Review [seven full days of ad metrics]. Classify each ad as keep, not tested, or recommend replacement, with reasons. Do not change the account.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare weekly creative replacements
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [metrics], [creative previews], and [prior review notes] for [product]. Identify ads untested across two review cycles. Propose a weekly creative batch with two or three ideas. Keep at least two active ads and request approval for each proposed change.

prompt_templates.title: Audit performance and delivery together
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [campaign and ad metrics], [currency], [historical benchmarks], [edit dates], and [delivery evidence]. Check totals and compare only matching products. Separate delivery failures, insufficient data, and performance concerns. Produce prioritized recommendations, creative briefs, and individual approval questions. Identify anything you could not inspect.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced account review with delivery diagnostics

output_examples.input: A USD ad set has seven full days since its last edit and a historical benchmark of USD 10 per conversation. One ad spent USD 14 with no conversations.
output: Keep the ad for now: it has spent 1.4 times its ad set's benchmark.
Classify it as not tested, rather than unsuccessful.

output_examples.input: After seven full days, ad A spent USD 30 with no conversations against a USD 10 historical benchmark. Three ads are active.
output: Recommend turning off ad A: it spent three times its ad set's benchmark without a conversation.

output_examples.input: An ad shows Active but has had no impressions for 52 hours. Billing and account quality details are unavailable.
output: Investigate delivery before judging the creative.
Check the Ad Library, billing, account quality, and then ad set settings.
Billing and account quality could not be inspected.
Do not replace the creative solely because impressions are zero.

best_practices: Use seven full days after significant edits and the prior 30-day cost-per-conversation benchmark when available.
Compare matching products, verify account currency, and reconcile ad totals with ad set and campaign totals.
Obtain explicit approval for each change, then verify and report the result in Ads Manager.
anti_patterns: Stop ads based on one bad day or spending below twice their ad set's benchmark.
Move budgets between unrelated products solely because one product has cheaper conversations.
Duplicate ad sets to fix performance or add new ads individually every day.

faq.question: Which campaigns does this skill address?
faq.answer: It targets Meta conversation campaigns, often using WhatsApp or Messenger, with approximately USD 1-5 daily per ad set.

faq.question: Does it automatically change my ads?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides guidance and requires explicit owner approval for each change. It includes no bundled account integration.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide account currency, spend, conversations, impressions, edit dates, and historical cost per conversation. Creative previews and delivery details support deeper reviews.

faq.question: When is there enough data to judge an ad?
faq.answer: The skill requires seven full days since significant edits and at least twice the ad set's benchmark in spend before labeling an ad unsuccessful.

faq.question: Can I compare different products by conversation cost?
faq.answer: The skill advises against ranking unrelated products together. Compare each ad set with its own history or ad sets promoting the same product.

faq.question: Does this produce statistically significant creative tests?
faq.answer: No. It treats small-budget creative testing as screening and asks reviewers to acknowledge that limitation.
